mapper.sql: s.mail_sign_idx, s.user_id, s.sign_nm, s.sign_html, s.default_new_yn, s.default_reply_yn, s.sort_order, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mail_signature s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.mail_sign_idx
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_signature ( user_id, sign_nm, sign_html, default_new_yn, default_reply_yn, sort_order, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{signNm}, COALESCE(#{signHtml,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), COALESCE(#{defaultNewYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{defaultReplyYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0), now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_signature SET sign_nm = COALESCE(#{signNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sign_nm), sign_html = COALESCE(#{signHtml,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sign_html), default_new_yn = COALESCE(#{defaultNewYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, default_new_yn), default_reply_yn = COALESCE(#{defaultReplyYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, default_reply_yn), sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, sort_order), updated_at = now() WHERE mail_sign_idx = #{signIdx} AND user_id = #{userId}
